description: This file defines the internal class AdoNetQueueAdapter, which implements the IQueueAdapter interface for ADO.NET providers. It manages queue creation, message batching, and logging for streaming data in Orleans using ADO.NET.

classes.name: AdoNetQueueAdapter
classes.description: Implements queue adapter for ADO.NET providers, handling message queuing and receiver creation.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates a queue receiver for the specified queue ID.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Queues a batch of messages asynchronously, converting events to payload and handling exceptions.

methods.name: LogFailedToQueueStreamMessage
methods.description: Logs an error when queuing a stream message fails.
